standard-dialogue.player: Hello, can I ask you a question?

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh yes, young fellow? Yes, what do you want?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Haera
standard-dialogue.text: Who's that you're talking to Hegir?

standard-dialogue.npc: Let me see, he appears to be a human of some sort.
What was your name again, human?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Haera
standard-dialogue.text: Well ask him what he wants then!

standard-dialogue.player: Errr... I don't know... A quest, maybe?

standard-dialogue.npc: He says he's looking for his quest!

standard-dialogue.speaker: Haera
standard-dialogue.text: What makes him think he lost his quest in here?

standard-dialogue.npc: What makes you think you lost your quest in here?

standard-dialogue.player: No no, I mean, do you have a task of some sort for me?

standard-dialogue.npc: Now he says he wants a task!

standard-dialogue.speaker: Haera
standard-dialogue.text: Stop talking to that human and get back in here before I have a task for you!

standard-dialogue.npc: No need to talk to me like that, Haera.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Haera
standard-dialogue.text: I'll talk to you in whatever way I like!

standard-dialogue.player: I think I hear someone calling my name in the distance...

steps.npc: What did you do that for?
